meta.source: scaffolded by /regency:ux-init; every name is a role (CODE-CONVENTIONS N3); values start from the Void/Paper palette
meta.edit: Change values here, then: python <regency>/scripts/ux.py build tokens.json --out theme.css

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page and editor background. Pure black in Void (U1): never a grey.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Side regions: rail, navigator, inspector, title bar, status bar, pane heads.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Active tab, cards, popovers, inputs, hovered rows.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between panes and rows. Decorative only, never a control edge.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Every control border (buttons, inputs, chips, switches). 3:1 or better on ground, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on ground, surface, surface-raised and every -soft fill.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, punctuation in code, pane-head labels.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Line numbers, inactive tabs, archived items, placeholders. Still 4.5:1 on the three grounds.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Brand, the primary action, selection, focus ring, writes, the main term in code. As text on the three grounds and accent-soft.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected row, active line, active rail item, chip that is on, reissued status. Text on it: ink or accent.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label on an accent fill (the primary button, a switch knob).

tokens.name: human
tokens.usage: The human actor (the Regent) and anything a human plays or pinned; the second kind of term in code. As text on the three grounds and human-soft.

tokens.name: human-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind human marks, pins and second-kind chips.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Passed check, issued output, added line, literal values in code. As text on the three grounds and ok-soft.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind ok and issued marks and added diff lines.

tokens.name: system
tokens.usage: The machine and the engine: structure keywords, modes, the gate, note severity, paths. As text on the three grounds and system-soft.

tokens.name: system-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind note marks and system chips.

tokens.name: fix
tokens.usage: Blocking problem (the output cannot be trusted), blocked status, removed line. Always with the word and the square mark.

tokens.name: fix-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind fix text and removed diff lines.

tokens.name: ask
tokens.usage: Missing information (never blocks), stale status, a required value left empty. Always with the word and the diamond mark.

tokens.name: ask-soft
tokens.usage: Fill behind ask text and the missing-value highlight in an output pane.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Paths and cross-references that open another file or view. Alias of system.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind the command palette and any modal layer.

families.sans: "IBM Plex Sans", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, "Segoe UI", sans-serif
families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "Cascadia Code", Consolas, Menlo, monospace

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: Hosted on Google Fonts (400, 500, 600). Dense tool UI: 13px body. A project may swap the family; the scale stays.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Everything in the interface that is not code.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase pane heads. Never a sentence.

groups.name: Code
groups.note: Hosted on Google Fonts (400, 500, 600). Every id, path, key, file name and code pane is mono.

spacing.note: 4px base. Dense by default: a row is 26px.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Chip padding, gap between a mark and its word.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside controls, navigator indent step.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Pane side padding, between rows of a card.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, between inspector sections.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between major groups.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Cover and empty-state margins.

radius.note: Nearly square: a working tool, not a toy.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Chips, gutter marks, rail badges, kbd hints.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, tabs, badges, rail items.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, popovers, toasts, settings sections.

tokens.name: row-h
tokens.usage: Navigator, problem and field-check rows.

tokens.name: bar-h
tokens.usage: Title bar and tab bar.

tokens.name: pane-head-h
tokens.usage: Pane heads, settings section heads.

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, navigation items.

tokens.name: status-h
tokens.usage: Status bar.

tokens.name: rail-w
tokens.usage: Mnemonic rail.

tokens.name: nav-w
tokens.usage: Navigator column (tree, list of items).

tokens.name: inspector-w
tokens.usage: Inspector column.

shadow.note: Void has no drop shadows: elevation is a lighter surface plus a hairline.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Popovers, palettes, toasts.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px ground gap, then 2px solid accent.
